nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$ and let $s$ and $s'$ be stores assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node. If $L$ is a list of identities below $n$ and $s'(i) = s(i)$ for every $i$ in $L$, then the contents of $s'$ at $L$ equal the contents of $s$ at $L$.
nodes.title: The payload list depends only on the listed cells

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$ and let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node. For every list $L$ of identities below $n$, the contents of $s$ at $L$ have the same length as $L$.
nodes.title: The payload list has one entry per identity

nodes.title: Contents after deleting a successor

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let $y$ be an identity such that $s(y)$ is a node, and let $s'$ be the store obtained from $s$ by deleting the successor of $y$. Then $s'(z) = s(z)$ for every identity $z \ne y$.
nodes.title: Deleting a successor leaves other cells unchanged

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let $y$ be an identity such that $s(y)$ is a node, and let $s'$ be the store obtained from $s$ by deleting the successor of $y$. nodes.title: Cells after deleting a successor

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let $y$ be an identity such that $s(y)$ is a node, and let $s'$ be the store obtained from $s$ by deleting the successor of $y$. Then for every identity $z$, either $s(z)$ and $s'(z)$ are both nothing, or both are nodes with the same payload.
nodes.title: Deleting a successor preserves payloads

nodes.title: Deleting the head removes the first identity

nodes.summary: Let a store assign to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node whose next pointer is an identity below $n$ or NIL, and let the head be an identity below $n$ or NIL. Deleting the head returns the store unchanged together with a new head: NIL if the head is NIL or the store entry at the head is empty, and otherwise the next pointer of the node stored at the head.
nodes.title: Deleting the head of a singly linked list

Then the contents of the store obtained by inserting $x$ after $i_k$ at the list…
nodes.title: Contents after singly-linked-list insertion

nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, and let $x$ and $y$ be identities whose store entries are nodes. For every identity $z$ with $z \ne y$ and $z \ne x$, cell $z$ of the store obtained by inserting $x$ after $y$ equals cell $z$ of $S$.

Let $c$ be the node of $x$ in $S$ with next pointer replaced by the next pointer of $y$ in $S$ if $z = x$, and the content of cell $z$ in $S$ otherwise. Then cell $z$ of the store obtained by inserting $x$ after $y$ is $c$ with…
nodes.title: Cells after singly-linked-list insertion

nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, and let $x$ and $y$ be identities whose store entries are nodes. For every identity $z$, cell $z$ of the store obtained by inserting $x$ after $y$ is empty exactly when cell $z$ of $S$ is empty, and otherwise holds a node with the same payload as the node in cell $z$ of $S$.
nodes.title: Singly-linked-list insertion preserves payloads

nodes.summary: Suppose the store $S$ with head $h$ represents the list of distinct identities $(i_0, \dots, i_{m-1})$. Let $k < m$, assume that the store entry of $i_k$ is a node, and let $x$ be an identity whose store entry is a node and which is not among $i_0, \dots, i_{m-1}$. Then the store obtained by inserting $x$ after $i_k$, with the same head $h$, represents the list $(i_0, \dots, i_k, x, i_{k+1}, \dots, i_{m-1})$.
nodes.title: Insertion into a represented singly linked list

Inserting $x$ after $y$ first replaces cell $x$ by the node of $x$ with next pointer replaced by the next pointer of $y$ in $S$, then, in the store so obtained, replaces the next pointer of the node in cell…
nodes.title: Inserting a node after another in a singly linked list

nodes.summary: A singly linked list node with payloads in $\alpha$ and identities in $\iota$ consists of a payload in $\alpha$ (the key together with any satellite data) and a next pointer, which is either an identity in $\iota$ or NIL.
nodes.title: Singly linked list node

For every identity $z \ne x$, cell $z$ of the store obtained by prepending $x$ to the list with head $h$ equals cell $z$ of $S$.
nodes.title: Frame property of prepending to a singly linked list

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let $\mathrm{head}$ be an identity below $n$ or NIL, and let $x$ be an identity such that $s(x)$ is a node. Then for every identity $z$ below $n$, the entry at $z$ of the store returned by Prepend on $s$, $\mathrm{head}$ and $x$ is the node $s(x)$ with its next pointer replaced by $\mathrm{head}$…
nodes.title: Store after prepending to a singly linked list

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let $\mathrm{head}$ be an identity below $n$ or NIL, and let $x$ be an identity such that $s(x)$ is a node. Then the head returned by Prepend on $s$, $\mathrm{head}$ and $x$ is $x$.
nodes.title: Prepending makes the node the head

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let $\mathrm{head}$ be an identity below $n$ or NIL, and let $x$ be an identity such that $s(x)$ is a node. Then the entry at $x$ of the store returned by Prepend on $s$, $\mathrm{head}$ and $x$ is the node $s(x)$ with its payload kept and its next pointer replaced by $\mathrm{head}$.
nodes.title: The prepended node points at the old head

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let $\mathrm{head}$ be an identity below $n$ or NIL, and let $x$ be an identity such that $s(x)$ is a node. If $s$ and $\mathrm{head}$ represent the list of identities $i_0, \dots, i_{k-1}$ and $x$ is none of $i_0, \dots, i_{k-1}$, then the store and head returned by Prepend on $s$,…
nodes.title: Prepending conses onto the represented list

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let a store assign to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, let the head be an identity below $n$ or NIL, and let $x$ be an identity whose store entry is a node. Prepending $x$ replaces the store entry at $x$ by the same node with its next pointer set to the head, leaves every other entry unchanged, and returns the updated store together with the new head $x$.
nodes.title: Prepending a node to a singly linked list

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, and let $\mathrm{head}$ be an identity below $n$ or NIL. If $s$ and $\mathrm{head}$ represent the list of identities $i_0, \dots, i_{k-1}$, then for every identity $i$ in this list the store entry $s(i)$ is a node.
nodes.title: Represented identities hold nodes

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, and let $\mathrm{head}$ be an identity below $n$ or NIL. If $s$ and $\mathrm{head}$ represent the list of identities $i_0, \dots, i_{k-1}$, then every entry of the contents of $s$ at $i_0, \dots, i_{k-1}$ is a payload rather than nothing.
nodes.title: Represented lists have no missing contents

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$, let $s$ be a store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node, and let $\mathrm{head}$ be an identity below $n$ or NIL. If $s$ and $\mathrm{head}$ represent the list of identities $i_0, \dots, i_{k-1}$, then $k \le n$.
nodes.title: Represented lists fit in the store

nodes.summary: Fix a capacity $n$ and let $s$ be any store assigning to each identity below $n$ either nothing or a singly linked list node. Then $s$ with head NIL represents the empty list of identities.
nodes.title: Representation of the empty singly linked list

The store and head represent the list of identities $i_0, \dots, i_{k-1}$ when these identities are pairwise distinct, the head is $i_0$ (and NIL when $k = 0$), and for each $j < k$ the store entry at $i_j$…
nodes.title: Store representing a singly linked list

nodes.summary: Suppose a node pool represents, from the head $h$, the list of distinct identities $\ell$. Then for every target payload $t$ and every fuel $f$ with $f \ge |\ell|$, fuel-bounded search for $t$ from $h$ with fuel $f$ returns the first identity in $\ell$ whose cell holds a node with payload $t$, and returns nothing if no identity in $\ell$ has this property.
nodes.title: Fuel-bounded search finds the first matching represented identity

nodes.summary: Given a node pool with $n$ cells, a target payload $t$, a fuel $f \in \mathbb{N}$ and a start $h$ that is either an identity in $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ or NIL, fuel-bounded search for $t$ from $h$ with fuel $f$ returns nothing if $f = 0$ or $h$ is NIL. Otherwise $h$ is an identity $i$: the search returns nothing if cell $i$ is unallocated, returns $i$ if the node in cell $i$ has payload $t$, and otherwise continues…
nodes.title: Fuel-bounded search in a singly-linked list

nodes.summary: If a node pool represents, from the head $h$, the list of distinct identities $\ell$, then for every target payload $t$ the search for $t$ from $h$ returns the first identity in $\ell$ whose cell holds a node with payload $t$, and returns nothing if no identity in $\ell$ has this property.
nodes.title: Search finds the first matching represented identity

nodes.summary: If a node pool represents, from the head $h$, the list of distinct identities $\ell$, then for every target payload $t$ the search for $t$ from $h$ returns nothing if and only if no identity in $\ell$ has a cell holding a node with payload $t$.
nodes.title: Search fails exactly when no represented node has the target payload

nodes.summary: If a node pool represents, from the head $h$, the list of distinct identities $\ell$, and the search for a target payload $t$ from $h$ returns an identity $x$, then $x$ belongs to $\ell$ and cell $x$ holds a node with payload $t$.
nodes.title: A successful search returns a matching represented identity

nodes.summary: Given a node pool with $n$ cells, a head $h$ that is either an identity in $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ or NIL, and a target payload $t$, the search for $t$ from $h$ is fuel-bounded search for $t$ from $h$ with fuel $n$. It follows next pointers from $h$ and returns the first visited identity whose node has payload $t$, returning nothing if it reaches NIL or an unallocated cell first, or if $n$ steps run out.
nodes.title: Search in a singly-linked list

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
